cohort: 200 patients who underwent LEEP at Srinagarind Hospital, Khon Kaen, Thailand, from January 2012 to February 2013
finding: The overall prevalence of post-LEEP complications was 16.5%, with previous caesarean section being the only independent predictor of complications.
mod_finding: Women with previous caesarean sections had a 3.9 times increased risk of post-LEEP complications compared to those with vaginal delivery.
